report.summary: In the window, stability complaints among negative reviews rose by 8.36 percentage points compared to the baseline. The total review count reached 1105 reviews with an 88.78 percent positive share, while the baseline total review volume was 5090 reviews with an 89.02 percent positive share. The estimated patch effect on positive share at 14 days was 0.9 points. Noise or seasonality is supported as the explanation. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are ruled out, whereas the patch remains inconclusive.
